14: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
31: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
37: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
68: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
74: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
79: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
80: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
82: While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn't need to sleep.
84: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then uses its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.
